title: Settings
openGallerySidebarByDefault: Open folder sidebar when gallery opens
externalDropOpenOnly: Open only, don't add to library
systemIntegrationError: MasonGallery couldn't read or update the system integration. Check your user account permissions and try again.
systemIntegrationWindowsHint: Adds MasonGallery commands to the classic Windows context menu under Show more options.
systemIntegrationMacosHint: Finder recognizes these sources through the signed application bundle. These declarations stay enabled and do not change your default apps.
systemIntegrationLinuxAppImageHint: Registers this AppImage with compatible Linux file managers. Move the AppImage first, then use Repair if its path changes later.
systemIntegrationLinuxPackageHint: These source types are registered by the installed Linux package and stay available while MasonGallery is installed.
systemIntegrationNoDefaultHint: Makes MasonGallery available as an option without changing default apps.
systemIntegrationFoldersHint: Open an image folder from its context menu or Open With list.
systemIntegrationArchivesHint: Open ZIP, RAR, 7Z, CBZ, and CBR files with MasonGallery.
inputPresetHint: Presets supply default bindings. Your custom bindings are kept when switching presets.
recordingHint: Press a key combination. Escape cancels; Delete clears. Use the key field to assign Escape or Delete.
recordingRejected: That key combination cannot be recorded. Try another.
invalidBinding: Enter a valid key and modifier combination. Ctrl-wheel is reserved for pinch zoom.
clickBindingHint: Mouse bindings apply to the image. Dragging never counts as a click. A single click waits when a double click is also assigned. Touch pinch remains available.
wheelSearchAliases: wheel navigation scroll previous next image page
zoomInSearchAliases: left mouse button zoom in enlarge
zoomOutSearchAliases: right mouse button zoom out shrink
